useCases.title: Passport & visa portals
useCases.blurb: Portals like the US DS-160, UK Gov, and Indian Passport Seva reject photos above 200KB or 240KB. PixelKit hits the exact KB in one pass — no guesswork with sliders.

useCases.title: Aadhaar & PAN updates
useCases.blurb: UIDAI portals cap Aadhaar scans at 2 MB and PAN uploads at 100–200 KB. Convert and compress without losing readable text on the scan.

useCases.title: Exam & job applications
useCases.blurb: SSC, UPSC, IBPS, NEET and most state portals reject photos and signatures above 20–50 KB. Hit the exact number every time.

useCases.title: Email attachments
useCases.blurb: Gmail, Outlook and most corporate mailboxes cap attachments at 10–25 MB. Compress a batch of photos in one pass so they send on the first try.

useCases.title: iPhone HEIC photos
useCases.blurb: iPhone saves photos as HEIC, which Windows and most web portals don't accept. Convert to JPG in your browser with no upload and no app install.

useCases.title: Website & CMS uploads
useCases.blurb: WordPress, Shopify and Webflow all have max upload sizes. Convert to WEBP and target exact KBs to keep pages fast and Core Web Vitals green.
